definitions.explanation: A label attached to merchandise showing its price.

examples.english: To look at the price tag.

examples.japanese: {値札|ねふだ}が{付|つ}いていない。
examples.english: There is no price tag attached.

examples.japanese: プレゼントにするので、{値札|ねふだ}を{外|はず}してください。
examples.english: Please remove the price tag because it's a gift.

notes:
A label or tag attached to merchandise showing its price. Commonly seen in stores, markets, and when discussing shopping.

FORMS:
{値|ね} (price, value) + {札|ふだ} (tag, card). The kanji {札|ふだ} is also read さつ ('banknote').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {値札|ねふだ}が{付|つ}く: to have a price tag
- {値札|ねふだ}を{外|はず}す: to remove a price tag
- {値札|ねふだ}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the price tag
- {値札|ねふだ}を{付|つ}け{替|か}える: to switch price tags

RELATED WORDS:
- {値段|ねだん}: price (general)
- {価格|かかく}: price (formal, written)
- {定価|ていか}: list price, retail price
